data_source: Already-certified local pre-2018 FX dataset (13 pairs, M1, 2010-2017)
scope: Prospectively freeze a SMALL V5 strategy universe. Test whether substantially different REPRESENTATIONS and LOW-TURNOVER structural decision rules extract robust price-only FX alpha that V1-V3's hand-crafted/threshold families missed.

holdout_firewall.2018_plus: ABSOLUTELY SEALED. No provider request, raw read, canonical read, or metadata outcome read.
holdout_firewall.pre_2018_role: DEVELOPMENT evidence only. NOT final independent validation.
holdout_firewall.if_survivors_found: STOP before 2018. Later separate authorization decides whether to consume holdout.

banned: seeding parameters from 20 V3 raw-positive candidates
turnover_philosophy: Prefer 0-3 entries/instrument/day. Execution on M1 BID/ASK. Signals from slower state.

S1_CONTINUOUS_STATE_SPACE_TREND.idea: Kalman local-linear trend. Signal = latent_slope / state_uncertainty. Continuous, not binary gates.

S2_LATENT_REGIME_MIXTURE.idea: Gaussian mixture on [return, vol, range, spread, trend]. Posterior state probs as continuous signal modifier.

S3_CROSS_SECTIONAL_RANKING.idea: Rank 13 pairs by [return, residual, trend_persistence]. Top vs bottom, top-2 vs bottom-2.

S4_FACTOR_RESIDUAL_DYNAMICS.idea: Causal PCA factor from panel. Residual momentum/drift at slow horizons.

S5_SEQUENCE_REPRESENTATION.idea: Small causal TCN or GRU. Inputs: returns, range, spread, time. Train on dev only. No arch search.
S5_SEQUENCE_REPRESENTATION.grid: 2 arch x 2 context x 6 horizon/seed variants

S6_SELF_SUPERVISED.reason: Would create large hyperparameter space. Does not meet 'clean implementation' criterion.

S7_COST_AWARE_OPTIMAL_STOPPING.idea: Enter/wait/abstain based on expected_move / cost / uncertainty / time_left. Deterministic rule, no RL.

splits.note: All pre-2018. All are DEVELOPMENT evidence with known lineage exposure. NOT pristine. Final independent evidence = 2018+ (SEALED).

cross_version.correction: Program-level sequential correction. Stricter threshold: alpha_eff = 0.05 / (1 + 1388/144).

activity_floor.note: Horizon-appropriate for low-turnover (15m-4h). Stricter for pooled/cross-sectional (S3, S4): min_trades=120.

outcome_lock: Once first V5 candidate P&L exists: NO changes to families, parameters, features, horizons, execution, costs, thresholds, statistics, survivor rule, date roles.
